Subject: Aligning buying journey constraints, SLA and next steps

Hi Amanda — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick written recap so we’re all aligned and I don’t miss any asks: 

1) Decision criteria you called out
- Latency: target P95 ~<= 160ms for generation workloads at ~512 tokens (primary).
- Cost: team level threshold is to keep unit costs competitive; rough internal target you mentioned was in the same ballpark as your current vendor — we flagged sub-$X per 1k as an example to model (we'll convert to per-M cost in the pricing deck).
- Deployment: starting preference = Dedicated (cloud, single-tenant). Private/VPC considered if scope expands to PHI or stricter data residency.
- SLA: ask is for standard 99.9% uptime; you also want a latency SLO for P95 that we can surface in contract language.

2) Buying process / stakeholders
- Economic buyer: Rajesh Patel (CTO) — will own final sign-off and budget.
- Procurement: Linda Gomez will lead PO/contracting steps.
- Security: Samir Desai will need SOC2 evidence, data retention and KMS details.

3) Next steps (proposed)
- We’ll send a short post-call recap + attachments (SOC2 summary, quick bench). (attached)
- Run an SRE-focused demo and throughput/latency validation: propose Thu Aug 26 — we’ll bring a 512-token benchmark and a dedicated-hosting cost sketch.
- Procurement kickoff with Linda once Rajesh gives a green light — we can prepare an editable SOW and term sheet.

If that matches your notes, I’ll schedule the technical demo and loop Karthik + Marcus to prepare numbers. Anything I missed or any corrected numbers (latency/cost) please call out.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
Attachments: postcall-recap.pdf; redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; 512-token-quick-bench.xlsx

- Please schedule SRE demo on Aug 26 (we have Rajesh available in the afternoon if you need him).
- Share the SOC2 excerpt and a short data-retention FAQ for Samir to review.
- Kicking procurement once we have the SOW and a preliminary cost model.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Amanda
